PROJECTS

Power BI · DAX · Excel

STRATEGIC HR & PAYROLL ANALYTICS

Executive-level insights into employee turnover, workforce demographics, and compensation structures — designed to support data-driven HR decisions across multiple branches.

📊 Tracked workforce dynamics across 6 branches — uncovering an 8.58% attrition rate and $11.60M in total payroll costs. Built advanced DAX measures including Median Salary Penetration Ratio to benchmark compensation competitiveness.

Power BI · DAX · Excel

SALARY & COST ANALYSIS

A deep-dive into payroll composition, branch-level salary distribution, and compensation benchmarking — giving HR leaders clarity on where money goes and how to optimize it.

💰 Revealed $11.60M total payroll with $5.59K average cost per employee. Salary package breakdown showed Basic Salary at 44.12% of total compensation. Median Salary Penetration Ratio highlighted Marine Projects as the highest-compensated branch.
Power BI DAX Power Query Excel
Python · Scikit-learn · Pandas · Seaborn

STUDENT PERFORMANCE PREDICTION

A regression model that predicts student exam scores based on lifestyle habits — including study hours, sleep, social media usage, diet quality, and attendance. Five algorithms were benchmarked to find the best fit, with full EDA and visual analysis.

🎯 Linear Regression outperformed all models with R² = 0.897 and MAE = 4.19 on 1,000 student records. Cross-validation confirmed stability across 5 folds (Mean R² = 0.894, Std = 0.019). Study hours and attendance were the strongest predictors of exam score.
